name: History
description: Source-led, AI-first historical archive with append-only news and price observations

write_policy.allowed: Connected GitHub repository tools may add immutable news and price JSON records and update their indexes.

reliability_rules: Use source URLs and preserve provenance.
Keep event/publication/observation time separate from collection time.
Validate records against their JSON schemas.
Do not infer missing prices, units, market types, timestamps, or sources.
Distinguish facts, attributed claims, analysis, and uncertainty.
Never claim a numeric AI accuracy without a disclosed human-labelled evaluation.
Source country is not a truth or neutrality score.
Use multiple independent reporting chains and primary records for contested claims.
Human-reviewed corrections may inform later prompts; no automatic self-verification.

automated_ingestion.mode: scheduled-and-manual; no external AI key required
sources: Iran Market Data public price feed
automated_ingestion.output: append-only news and price JSON records proposed through a review pull request
